entities.name: Serafín Luis Alberto Cartagena Ocaña
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Serafín Luis Alberto Cartagena Ocaña O.F.M. was an Ecuadorian Roman Catholic prelate who was consecrated a bishop in 1983 and served as the vicar apostolic of Zamora in Ecuador from 1982 to 2003. He was the prefect apostolic of Galápagos from 1980 to 1982.
